status: Anwendung des eingefrorenen V0.4-Gelände-Modells; keine neue Auswertung, kein Training, kein Test
purpose: relative order of terrain cells inside a user-chosen radius: which slopes to look at first when heavy rain is expected; the heavy-rain switch only selects this view and never changes the classes
not_claimed: any effect of the expected rain on the classes (no weather input)

model.provenance: V0.4 final static conditional logit, trained only on the 123 development events (reports/v04/); same model as config/wirkungskette_v01.json review_points; read only, never refitted here
model.score: linear conditional-logit score; only its rank inside the radius is used

terrain.dem: read-only Skadi tile cache (data/raw/terrain, data/v04/cache/terrain_tiles); never downloaded here; Skadi over Austria is practically SRTMGL1 v3 (February 2000)
terrain.feature_code: preslide.hangmap.build.build_features (V0.5 static_features, byte-identical algorithm to preslide.v04.terrain.static_features)
terrain.reference_date_rule: every DEM tile must have a provider Last-Modified date before this date

land_cover.rule: V0.4 rule: CLC2018 for dates from 2019-01-01; no or several polygons covering a cell = not assessable (counted)

geology.source: GeoSphere 1:500 000 lithology, five V0.4 classes; missing or ambiguous = not assessable (counted)

area.inside_austria: the chosen centre must lie inside the GISCO Austria boundary; cells outside Austria are counted, not assessed

classes_rule: same logic as preslide.wirkungskette.core.review_classes: descending rank of the score among all assessable cells inside the radius; top 5 % = Prüfstufe 1, next 15 % = Prüfstufe 2, rest unmarked. Relative inside the radius only.

review_points.rule: highest scores first among Prüfstufe-1 cells; a cell is taken only if >= separation_m (EPSG:31287 metres) from every taken cell (preslide.wirkungskette.core.select_release_points)

municipalities.point: shapely representative_point of the municipality polygon (inside the polygon, not the centroid)

cache.key: identity = SHA-256 of rounded request and this configuration; sidecar SHA-256 verified on every read
